changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Generate 3 months of variable-throughput event data across all Acme Corp channels using generate_series.
changeSet.sql: WITH acme_channels AS ( SELECT c.id AS channel_id, c.name AS channel_name FROM channel c INNER JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE o.slug = 'acme-corp' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ), -- 10-minute base slots over 3 months, ~40% randomly dropped for variable throughput time_slots AS ( SELECT generate_series( (NOW() - INTERVAL '3 months')::timestamptz, NOW()::timestamptz, INTERVAL '30 minutes' ) AS slot ), active_slots AS ( SELECT slot FROM time_slots WHERE random() > 0.40 ), event_data AS ( SELECT ac.channel_id, ac.channel_name, s.slot, -- Weighted severity: 65% OK, 22% WARNING, 13% CRITICAL CASE WHEN random() < 0.65 THEN 'OK' WHEN random() < 0.87 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'CRITICAL' END AS severity FROM acme_channels ac CROSS JOIN active_slots s ) INSERT INTO event (channel_id, severity, title, message, metadata, timestamp) SELECT ed.channel_id, ed.severity, -- Realistic titles per channel CASE ed.channel_name WHEN 'Acme API Gateway' THEN (ARRAY['Request Routed', 'Rate Limit Hit', 'Upstream Timeout', 'Cache Miss', 'Health Check OK'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int] WHEN 'Acme Payment Service' THEN (ARRAY['Transaction Processed', 'Payment Declined', 'Fraud Score High', 'Settlement Complete', 'Refund Initiated'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int] WHEN 'Acme User Auth' THEN (ARRAY['Login Success', 'Token Refreshed', 'Login Failed', 'Session Expired', 'MFA Verified'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int] WHEN 'Acme Background Jobs' THEN (ARRAY['Job Completed', 'Job Queued', 'Job Retried', 'Job Failed', 'Queue Flushed'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int] WHEN 'Acme Production Events' THEN (ARRAY['Deploy Succeeded', 'Health Check Passed', 'Error Rate Spike', 'Rollback Triggered', 'Service Restarted'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int] ELSE (ARRAY['Event Received', 'Status Update', 'Metric Report', 'Heartbeat', 'Notification'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int] END AS title, -- Message matches severity CASE ed.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'Critical issue detected in ' || ed.channel_name || ' — immediate attention required' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 'Warning threshold exceeded in ' || ed.channel_name || ' — monitoring closely' ELSE 'Normal operation for ' || ed.channel_name || ' — all systems nominal' END AS message, -- Rich metadata jsonb_build_object( 'source', (ARRAY['api-server', 'worker-1', 'worker-2', 'scheduler', 'gateway'])[FLOOR(random() * 5 + 1)::int], 'channel_name', ed.channel_name, 'environment', (ARRAY['production', 'staging'])[FLOOR(random() * 2 + 1)::int], 'region', (ARRAY['eu-west-1', 'us-east-1', 'ap-southeast-1'])[FLOOR(random() * 3 + 1)::int], 'response_time_ms', (random() * 800 + 20)::int, 'cpu_usage', ROUND((random() * 85 + 5)::numeric, 1), 'memory_mb', (random() * 8192)::int, 'request_count', (random() * 2000)::int ) AS metadata, -- Jitter ±4 minutes around the slot ed.slot + (random() * INTERVAL '8 minutes' - INTERVAL '4 minutes') AS timestamp FROM event_data ed ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Simulate 5 incident bursts spread across the 3-month window with higher CRITICAL ratio for Acme Corp channels.
changeSet.sql: WITH acme_channels AS ( SELECT c.id AS channel_id, c.name AS channel_name FROM channel c INNER JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE o.slug = 'acme-corp' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ), incident_starts AS ( SELECT unnest(ARRAY[ NOW() - INTERVAL '85 days' + INTERVAL '10 hours', NOW() - INTERVAL '65 days' + INTERVAL '14 hours', NOW() - INTERVAL '45 days' + INTERVAL '3 hours', NOW() - INTERVAL '20 days' + INTERVAL '17 hours', NOW() - INTERVAL '5 days' + INTERVAL '9 hours' ]) AS incident_start ), burst_slots AS ( SELECT i.incident_start + (n * INTERVAL '30 seconds') AS event_time, n FROM incident_starts i CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 24) AS n ) INSERT INTO event (channel_id, severity, title, message, metadata, timestamp) SELECT ac.channel_id, -- Higher CRITICAL ratio during bursts: first 8 CRITICAL, next 12 WARNING, rest OK CASE WHEN bs.n < 8 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN bs.n < 20 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OK' END AS severity, CASE WHEN bs.n < 8 THEN 'Incident Detected' WHEN bs.n < 20 THEN 'Recovery In Progress' ELSE 'Service Restored' END AS title, CASE WHEN bs.n < 8 THEN 'Critical incident in ' || ac.channel_name || ' — escalating to on-call team' WHEN bs.n < 20 THEN 'Recovery actions underway for ' || ac.channel_name || ' — monitoring metrics' ELSE 'Service fully restored for ' || ac.channel_name || ' — incident resolved' END AS message, jsonb_build_object( 'source', 'incident-detector', 'channel_name', ac.channel_name, 'incident_id', 'INC-' || LPAD((random() * 9999)::int::text, 4, '0'), 'severity_level', CASE WHEN bs.n < 8 THEN 'P1' WHEN bs.n < 20 THEN 'P2' ELSE 'P3' END, 'affected_users', (random() * 5000)::int ) AS metadata, bs.event_time AS timestamp FROM acme_channels ac CROSS JOIN burst_slots bs -- Target only 2 random channels per burst to keep it realistic WHERE ac.channel_id IN ( SELECT channel_id FROM acme_channels ORDER BY random() LIMIT 2 ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Create org-level watchlist "Acme Operations Dashboard" with all Acme Corp channels.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO watchlist (name, description, user_id, organization_id, configuration, filters, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'Acme Operations Dashboard', 'Organisation-wide operations dashboard covering all Acme Corp channels. Configured for real-time monitoring with severity grouping.', 1, (SELECT id FROM organization WHERE slug = 'acme-corp'), jsonb_build_object( 'channelIds', ( SELECT jsonb_agg(c.id ORDER BY c.created_at) FROM channel c INNER JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE o.slug = 'acme-corp' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ), jsonb_build_object( 'timeRange', '24h', 'onlyCritical', false, 'sortBySeverity', true, 'groupedView', true ), (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '55 days', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
